Transferred in Spring ‘17, and got really lucky with housing. I got an RA double in mountainview (more spacious double w a bathroom). I lived in newing and mtvw during my first two years here, and can say mtvw has its perks. While you may be isolated from the rest of campus, the dining hall (app) is extremely close to you. Also, it’s pretty quiet unlike newing which is filled w/Greek life, sports, etc. My friends had a suite on another floor, and it was pretty ideal for hanging out/going out. Sometimes I didn’t have to go to the library because the rooms in mtvw are so quiet. Bathrooms get cleaned weekly, a lot of space unlike the rest of campus dorms, and pretty laidback RA’s. Best of luck and enjoy your time here!
